subScenes.name: 节日打招呼
subScenes.description: 偶遇时用节日祝福开启对话，如'Merry Christmas!'

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友或同事在节日期间主动打招呼

followUps.text: Thanks! Hope you have a wonderful holiday too!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！也希望你度过一个美好的假期！

followUps.text: Same to you! Got any plans for the break?
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！假期有什么安排吗？

followUps.text: Thanks, I’m just relaxing this year.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，今年我就想好好休息一下。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于朋友或同事间自然、轻松的节日问候互动，回应需体现真诚与社交温度

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事在办公室或社交场合提及圣诞节

followUps.text: Merry Christmas! I’m heading to my family’s place this weekend.
followUps.text_cn: 圣诞快乐！我这周末要回家人那里。

followUps.text: Thanks! I’m not celebrating Christmas, but happy holidays anyway!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！我不庆祝圣诞节，但也祝你节日愉快！

followUps.text: You too! Did you get that gift I sent?
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！收到我寄的礼物了吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于多元文化环境，回应需兼顾节日语境与个人立场

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 新年伊始，朋友或同事在见面时表达新年祝福

followUps.text: Happy New Year! Let’s catch up soon — I’ve missed our chats!
followUps.text_cn: 新年快乐！我们尽快聚一聚吧——我好想和你聊聊了！

followUps.text: Thanks! 2025 is going to be my year to finally start that project.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！2025年我终于要开始那个项目了！

followUps.text: Same to you! I’m still recovering from last night’s party…
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！我还在从昨晚的派对中缓过来呢……

qaPairs.usageNote: 新年问候常伴随个人状态或计划分享，回应宜自然带点个性，避免机械重复

subScenes.name: 询问假期计划
subScenes.description: 自然询问对方节日有何安排，如'Any plans for the holidays?'

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have any plans for the holiday?

followUps.text: I'm heading to the mountains for a few days—just want to relax and get away from the city.
followUps.text_cn: 我要去山里待几天，只想放松一下，远离城市。

followUps.text: Actually, I'm staying home—I’ve got a ton of work to catch up on.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我待在家，有一堆工作要补。

followUps.text: I’m not sure yet—I’m waiting to hear back from my family about their plans.
followUps.text_cn: 我还不确定，正在等家人回复他们的安排。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友间自然询问假期安排，回应可体现个人偏好、现实限制或不确定性，符合真实社交语境。

qaPairs.triggerText: What are you doing over the break?

followUps.text: I’m visiting my parents in the countryside—they’ve been asking me to come for ages!
followUps.text_cn: 我要回乡下看父母，他们盼我回去很久了！

followUps.text: I’m thinking of taking a short trip abroad—maybe Japan, if I can book flights in time.
followUps.text_cn: 我考虑出国短途旅行，如果能及时订到机票，可能去日本。

followUps.text: Honestly? I’m just going to binge-watch shows and sleep in. No big plans.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话？我就宅着追剧、睡懒觉，没什么大计划。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应可展现积极计划、犹豫中的可能性或轻松随意的态度，符合职场/朋友间轻松对话风格。

qaPairs.triggerText: Any fun plans for the holidays?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 假期有什么有趣的安排吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友间轻松询问假期计划

followUps.text: Yeah! I’m going on a road trip with some friends—we’re driving along the coast.
followUps.text_cn: 有！我和几个朋友要自驾游，沿着海岸线开。

followUps.text: Not really—I’m broke this month, so I’m just saving up for next year.
followUps.text_cn: 没有，这个月没钱了，只能攒着等明年再计划。

followUps.text: I’m debating between volunteering locally or just chilling at home—still deciding.
followUps.text_cn: 我在纠结是本地做志愿者还是干脆在家放松，还没决定。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应需体现真实生活中的多样性：社交、经济限制或决策犹豫，避免完美回答，增强真实感。

subScenes.name: 分享个人计划
subScenes.description: 简单分享自己的节日安排，如'I'll stay home and relax.'

qaPairs.triggerText: What are your plans for the holiday?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友间在节日临近时询问个人安排，属于社交场景中的分享个人计划

followUps.text: I'm going to visit my parents in the countryside.
followUps.text_cn: 我要去乡下看望父母。

followUps.text: Not sure yet—I might just relax at home.
followUps.text_cn: 还不确定，可能就在家休息。

followUps.text: I’m thinking of traveling, but I haven’t booked anything yet.
followUps.text_cn: 我考虑去旅行，但还没订票。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友或同事间轻松询问节日安排，回应应自然、真实，避免过度正式

qaPairs.triggerText: Are you doing anything special for the holiday?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你假期有什么特别安排吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事在节前闲聊中试探性询问个人计划，常见于办公室社交

followUps.text: Yeah, I’m having a small gathering with friends on New Year’s Eve.
followUps.text_cn: 有，我打算和朋友在除夕夜办个小聚会。

followUps.text: Nah, I’m just catching up on sleep and shows.
followUps.text_cn: 没有，就补觉和追剧。

followUps.text: I’d love to, but I have to work that week.
followUps.text_cn: 我很想，但我那周要上班。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应时可体现态度倾向（积极/消极/无奈），符合真实社交中的情绪表达

qaPairs.triggerText: Any fun plans for the break?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 假期有什么好玩的安排吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 轻松语境下朋友间发起的开放式节日计划询问，常见于校园或年轻职场群体

followUps.text: I’m finally going to try that new hot spring resort everyone’s talking about!
followUps.text_cn: 我终于要去试试大家都在说的那个温泉度假村了！

followUps.text: Not really—I’m broke this month.
followUps.text_cn: 没什么，这个月手头紧。

followUps.text: Maybe—I’m waiting to hear if my sister can join me.
followUps.text_cn: 可能吧，我得等我妹妹能不能一起来。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应可带情绪色彩（兴奋、无奈、犹豫），体现真实社交中的非完美表达

subScenes.name: 表达美好祝愿
subScenes.description: 再次祝福对方，强化积极社交氛围，如'Have a wonderful new year!'

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友在节日期间向你表达祝福

followUps.text: Thanks! Wishing you a wonderful holiday season too!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！也祝你度过一个美好的节日季！

followUps.text: Thanks, you too!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，你也是！

followUps.text: Haha, same to you—hope I don’t eat all the cookies before New Year!
followUps.text_cn: 哈哈，你也是！希望我在新年之前别把所有饼干都吃光了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于朋友、同事之间的节日问候互动，回应需自然、有温度，避免过于正式或机械。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事在办公室里向你道圣诞祝福

followUps.text: Merry Christmas to you too! Hope you get some well-deserved rest!
followUps.text_cn: 你也圣诞快乐！希望你能好好休息一下！

followUps.text: Thanks! I’m actually off next week, so I’ll celebrate early!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！我下周休假，所以提前庆祝啦！

followUps.text: Same! And happy Hanukkah if you’re celebrating!
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！如果你在过光明节，也祝你光明节快乐！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于职场或熟人之间的节日问候，回应可适当加入个人生活细节，增强真实感。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友在跨年时发来新年祝福

followUps.text: Happy New Year! Let’s plan a call or meet up soon—I’ve missed our chats!
followUps.text_cn: 新年快乐！我们尽快约个电话或见面吧——我好想和你聊聊了！

followUps.text: Thanks! Same to you—hope this year’s better than the last!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！你也是！希望今年比去年好！

followUps.text: Haha, same! And may my Wi-Fi never crash again this year!
followUps.text_cn: 哈哈，你也是！愿我今年的Wi-Fi再也不要断了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于亲密朋友或长期熟人之间的新年互动，回应可带情感或幽默，增强亲密度。

subScenes.name: 礼貌告别
subScenes.description: 用友好语句结束对话，如'Gotta go, see you soon!'

qaPairs.triggerText: Well, I should head out — have a great evening!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 嗯，我该走了——祝你晚上愉快！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友或同事在节日聚会结束时礼貌告别

followUps.text: Thanks for coming! Have a safe trip home!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你来！路上小心！

followUps.text: Same to you! Let’s catch up before the next holiday!
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！咱们节前再约一次吧！

followUps.text: Yeah, me too — this was such a nice get-together!
followUps.text_cn: 是啊，我也这么觉得——这次聚会真开心！

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于节日聚会或社交活动结束时，回应对方的告别，保持友好氛围

qaPairs.triggerText: I’ve got to run — happy holidays!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事在节前下班时匆忙告别

followUps.text: You too! Enjoy your time off!
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！好好享受假期！

followUps.text: Wait — can I give you a little gift? It’s just a small token!
followUps.text_cn: 等一下——我能送你个小礼物吗？只是心意！

followUps.text: Oh, really? I didn’t get you anything… but thanks so much!
followUps.text_cn: 啊？我都没准备礼物……但还是非常感谢！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于节前匆忙告别场景，回应需兼顾礼貌与情感温度

qaPairs.triggerText: It’s been great catching up — I’ll let you get back to your night!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 和你聊得很开心——不打扰你了，你继续吧！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友在节日聚会尾声主动为对方留出空间

followUps.text: Don’t be silly — stay a bit longer! We’re just getting started!
followUps.text_cn: 别这么说——再待一会儿吧！我们才刚聊嗨呢！

followUps.text: Thanks for understanding — I really needed this chat!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你体谅——我真的很需要这次聊天！

followUps.text: Same here — let’s do this again next month?
followUps.text_cn: 我也是——下个月我们再约一次？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于深度社交互动后的温和告别，回应需体现情感共鸣与关系维护
